name: compliance-skills
description: Mechanical, fully offline document-consistency checkers for contracts, invoices, tender/bidding documents and ad copy. Every finding quotes the exact source line and can be recomputed from the same input - no model, no network. 合同 / 票据 / 招投标 / 广告文案的机械核对工具。

owner.name: 河南樵夫网络科技有限公司

plugins.name: contract-consistency-check-free
plugins.description: Deterministic contract consistency check (English and Chinese): party-name, date and amount contradictions, leftover placeholders, broken clause cross-references, defined-term hygiene.

plugins.name: invoice-consistency-check-free
plugins.description: Deterministic invoice/receipt consistency check (English and Chinese): line arithmetic, itemised totals, tax computation, gross-up, amounts in words vs figures, payee/issuer mismatch, date logic, duplicate invoices, leftover placeholders.

plugins.name: bidguard-quote-audit-free
plugins.description: Mechanical audit of a bid quotation sheet: line arithmetic (amount = quantity x unit price) and missing-field detection. Free tier of a larger checker.

plugins.name: collusionscreen-collusion-screening-free
plugins.description: Cross-bidder collusion screening: shared contact details and cross-appearing project personnel, with output desensitised.

plugins.name: bidcheckup-batch-compliance-free
plugins.description: Batch check of multiple bidders' quotation sheets, grouped per bidder with a per-bidder verdict.

plugins.name: tenderaudit-full-compliance-free
plugins.description: Tender document mechanical check-up: per-bidder quotation arithmetic plus leftover template placeholder scanning.

plugins.name: adcheckup-content-compliance-free
plugins.description: Ad-copy compliance pre-check: absolute-superlative term detection with exemption reasoning under China's enforcement guidelines.
